name: USACOArena
description: USACOArena is an interactive ACM-ICPC style coding benchmark that evaluates autonomous agents under a strict credit budget, where every decision consumes credits from a fixed pool. It transforms coding evaluation into a dynamic resource management challenge, assessing agents' efficiency and cost-awareness in addition to accuracy.
reputation: A recent interactive coding benchmark proposal with limited public adoption so far, mainly of interest for agentic coding and budget-aware evaluation.
notes: Focuses on balancing accuracy with resource constraints such as tokens, tests, and time in coding tasks.
